pearls.purpose: The admin companion grain for the ccash constellation. Holds policy state (allowed templates, station tree, hook allowlist, manifest pins) and exposes an AdminGate over Powerbox. Operator ccash grains claim the AdminGate to read policy; admin promotions and policy changes flow back through Identity Gate. No browser UI — Powerbox-claim only.

offers.name: ccash-admin-gate
offers.purpose: Surface configuration to peer ccash operator grains (read policy, fetch template, list allowed hooks).

offers.name: policy-attest
offers.purpose: Sign a Squads-rooted attestation that a given policy snapshot was approved at time T.
